content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?NASA's Johnson Space Center's PostNASA's Johnson Space Center Verified accountMarch 29 at 3:00 PM · Shared with PublicWho's who in mission control? From attitude to propulsion, each flight controller is trained and certified in a specific system aboard the Orion spacecraft. CAPCOM, or capsule communicator, relays all team updates to the Artemis II crew, serving as the single voice they hear from Mission Control. The guidance, navigation, and control officer operates Orion’s navigation and flight control software and is responsible for the spacecraft’s orientation in space. The flight activities officer leads the preparation of the timeline for the flight plan to meet mission objectives and manages coordination of real-time changes in crew activities. These are just a few of the flight controllers making the mission happen real-time from Houston.
